welcome.title: Hands touching and crossing
welcome.text: Steps without windows come first: do what each one says with your fingers while the cameras record your hands. Then windows will appear in front of you: they don't move or click.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Hands together
sections.intro: Both hands touching, laced and crossing each other, mostly with your palms toward you. There's no wrong way: what helps is the fingers of both hands moving while they touch.

prompts.text: Both hands up, palms toward you. Touch matching fingertips together, like a steeple,|then tap each pair of fingertips together one at a time.
Lace your fingers together, open and close them,|twist the hands around and pull them apart again.
Touch each finger of your left hand with your right index, as if counting on it.|Palms toward you.

switch.text: Now the other way: your left index touches each finger of your right hand.|Palms toward you.

prompts.text: Cross your wrists in an X, palms toward you, and keep the fingers moving.|Uncross and cross the other way round.

switch.to: each hand on the other side
switch.text: Arms crossed: right hand out to your left, left hand out to your right,|fingers moving.

prompts.text: Pass one hand slowly in front of the other and back, palms toward you,|fingers moving.
Hold your left wrist with your right hand while the left hand's fingers move, its palm toward you.|Then hold one of its fingers instead.

switch.text: Now the left hand holds the right wrist, then one of its fingers,|while the right hand's fingers move, its palm toward you.

prompts.text: Slow claps, rub your palms together, then stack the hands:|one palm on the other's back, swapping which is on top.
Any of these close to your face, about a forearm's length away, palms toward you:|fingertips touching, fingers laced, one hand over the other.

sections.title: Arms crossed
sections.intro: Two windows, left and right. Use them with your arms crossed: the right hand on the left window, the left hand on the right. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hands.

prompts.text: Arms crossed. Each lit button says L or R: poke it with that hand,|the right hand on the left window and the left hand on the right.
